items.lede: Google is making it easier to build and use personal Android apps created with AI, without having to make them available to everyone on the Play Store.
items.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android

items.lede: The company is revamping the Play Store for the AI era with changes to publishing, recommendations and more.
items.title: Google will let you distribute vibe-coded Android apps with just a Google account

items.lede: It just got a whole lot easier to vibe code the exact Android app you need – no developer experience required.
items.title: Google lets you make personal Android apps for free now – with just prompts

items.lede: Google plans to help turn those personal AI-generated apps into wide releases.
items.title: Google wants to host your personal vibe-coded apps in the Play Store
